product.name: Junction Platform
product.description: An API-driven infrastructure platform that connects healthcare organizations to laboratory testing, wearable devices, medical devices, and health data workflows.

product.name: Lab Testing API
product.description: An API and operational service for ordering laboratory tests, coordinating specimen collection, and delivering results through a nationwide lab network.

product.name: Device Connectivity
product.description: A connectivity service for integrating data from more than 300 wearables, medical devices, and health tools into healthcare applications.

product.name: Continuous Device Data Monitoring
product.description: A monitoring and analytics service that converts high-volume device data into clinically relevant trends and actionable health insights.

product.name: Operational Support for Diagnostics
product.description: A managed operations service covering result tracking, patient reminders, exception handling, and diagnostic workflow coordination.

product.name: At-Home Diagnostics
product.description: A white-labeled at-home testing service that manages kit fulfillment, specimen collection workflows, laboratory processing, and results delivery.
